1.steps:
1- Go to Network > interface page and click on interface edit button (any switch port interface i.e X2 - X8).
  2- Set 'Zone' to LAN.
  3- verify that 'IP Assignment' drop down box has 'PortShield Switch Mode' option available.
  4- verify that only that interfaces belongs to LAN Zone are available under available 'PortShiled to' drop down box.
  5- Select any interface which is already a mamber of LAN zone e.g X0.
  6- Click OK and verify that the interface can be portshield to X0 (or any other selected interface).
  7- Edit any other interface, set the zone to WAN and verify that 'PortShield Switch Mode' option is not available under 'IP Assignment' drop down box.
  8- Try to portshield to DMZ, WLAN, trusted, public and wireless zone.
1.title: Testing Portshield eligibility of an interface
1.result:
1.Only switch ports are eligible to be grouped.  
  2.You can add PortShield interfaces only to Trusted, Public, and Wireless zones.

2.steps:
1- First decide which eligible interface is going to represent the Portshield Group, this interface would be Portshield group interface or portshield host.
  2- Configure Portshield group interface: - Zone must be set to LAN/DMZ - Portshield group interface cannot be a member of another Portshield Group. - Configure IP address etc. for the interface.
  3- Configure additional Portshield member interfaces: - Zone must be set to LAN /DMZ. - IP setting must be set to Portshield Switch Mode. - Select the configured Portshield group interface using 'Portshield To' drop down box.
2.title: Creating a Portshield Group
2.result: Verify the creation of Portshield Group and Group Interface IP address should be pinged from any of the member interfaces.

6.steps:
Following Configuration Restrictions need to be checked.
  1- Zone setting on Portshield group interface cannot be changed as long as there is at least one interface that has 'Portshield To' interface pointing to it.
  2- Once an interface is set to Portshield Switch Mode, it cannot be configured for routing
  3- VLAN sub-interfaces cannot be added on Portshield Member interfaces except the group interface iself.
  4- If routing is already enabled on the interface , any attempt to set the IP setting to Portshield Switch Mode will result in an error message.
  5- If there are VLAN sub-interfaces already attached to an interface, there are no 'Portshield Switch Mode' for the interface.
  6- Once an interface is set to Portshield Switch Mode, its address objects should not be available for use when configuring different policies.
6.title: Configuration restrictions after an interface is configured in Portshield Switch Mode
6.result: Verify that all the above mentioned configurations are restricted.

7.steps:
1- Reconfigure IP setting of any portshield member interface from Portshield Switch Mode to Static and configure IP address etc.
  2- Go to Network/Address Objects page and verify that default address objects are added back.
  3- Go to Network/NAT Policy page and verify that default NAT policies are added back.
  4- Go to Network/Route page and verify that default interface route is added back.
7.title: Removing an interface from a Portshield Group
7.result: Verify that all the above mentioned configurations are restricted.

12.steps:
1- Portshield X3 & X4 to X5 AND X6 & X7 to X8
  2- Connect PC-A to X3, PC-B to X5, PC-C to X4 and PC-D to X6
  3- Flush arp table on PC-A
  4- Run ethreal on PC-C and PC-D
  5- From PC-A ping PC-B
12.title: Verify that broadcast frames are flooded to all portshield group member interfaces
12.result: Arp frames for PC-B should be seen on PC-C and not on PC-D.

14.steps:
1- Portshield X3 to X5.
  2- Connect a router (sonicwall device can also be used if router is not available) to X5.
  3- Connect a PC A to X3 and PC-B to router's other interface.
  4- Enable Routing on X5.
14.title: Routing on a Portshield Group interface
14.result: Verify IP connectivity from PC-A connected to X3 to PC-B behind the router

15.steps:
1- Portshield X3, X4 and X5 to X6.
  2- Configure DHCP server on a Portshield Group Interface X6.
   3- Connect PC-A, PC-B and PC-C to X3, X4 and X5 interfaces
15.title: DHCP on a Portshield Group
15.result: Verify that PC-A, PC-B and PC-C obtain IP addresses via DHCP.

17.title: Verify traffic connectivity after portshield host interface link down.
17.result:
in step 4, 5, 6, both forwarding and management traffic must be succeed;
